gui.eminus.settings.title: Eminus Settings
gui.eminus.settings.ingestion.hint.on: chunks you see are added to LOD.
gui.eminus.settings.ingestion.hint.off: nothing new is added; LOD shows what it already has.
gui.eminus.settings.lod_quality.hint.ult: see-through leaves, grass and flowers, textures at full resolution.
gui.eminus.settings.lod_quality.hint.hig: opaque leaves, no grass or flowers.
gui.eminus.settings.lod_quality.hint.med: as High, with textures at half resolution.
gui.eminus.settings.lod_quality.hint.low: as Medium, with no corner occlusion.
gui.eminus.settings.lod_quality.hint.cus: your own voxel size, leaves, grass and flowers, textures and corner occlusion, set with Custom Settings... beside the slider.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.hint: Set the five values Custom uses, one by one. Available when LOD quality is Custom.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.title: Custom LOD Quality
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.nearest_v: How many blocks one voxel covers at LOD's nearest edge. Each step up stores LOD coarser. Changing this reads the chunks around you again.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.leaves.hi: leaves in LOD keep their holes at every distance.
The game's See-Through Leaves option does not change LOD. The leaf faces inside a canopy show only where a voxel is 1 block.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.grass_and: grass, ferns, flowers and saplings are drawn in LOD.
gui.eminus.settings.custom_lod.corner_oc: corners where blocks meet darken across all of LOD, as Smooth Lighting does nearby.
only the nearest part of LOD darkens them, with a brightness step where it meets the rest.
no corners darken; canopies and the bottoms of walls look brighter.
Needs the game's Smooth Lighting on.
gui.eminus.settings.far_render_cells.hin: How far LOD reaches. The cost grows with the square of this distance: more to draw each frame and more video memory.
gui.eminus.settings.worker_threads.hint: Background threads that build LOD. More threads catch up faster but take more time from the game's own chunk building; fewer do the opposite.
gui.eminus.settings.detail_distance.hint: How far out the finer detail of LOD reaches. Each step up doubles that distance and costs more video memory. A higher screen resolution reaches further at the same step.
gui.eminus.settings.detail_distance.limi: Not reached right now. The video memory set aside for LOD is full, so LOD is drawn coarser than this setting asks.
gui.eminus.settings.fog.hint.on: fog over LOD carries on from the game's own fog and is full at the LOD distance.
gui.eminus.settings.fog.hint.off: LOD stays clear, and the open-air fog of the loaded chunks goes too.
gui.eminus.settings.fog.hint.note: Fog in the Nether, from a boss, under water or from blindness stays either way.
gui.eminus.settings.fade.hint.on: LOD fades out over its last 512 blocks.
gui.eminus.settings.fade.hint.off: LOD ends in a hard line.
gui.eminus.settings.shader_pack_lod.hint: How LOD is drawn under a shader pack without Eminus support.
drawn over the pack's image in Eminus's own look.
a pack that supports Distant Horizons draws it, with the pack's light and fog but one flat color per block.
A pack made for Eminus always draws LOD itself. Changing this reloads the shader pack.
a shader pack made for Eminus may sway grass, leaves and water in LOD, as it does nearby.
nothing in LOD moves, which saves the GPU time it costs.
Changing this reloads the shader pack.
